properties.description: **ePlan**Remodel the existing elevator lobby enclosure on the 21st floor of a highrise office building . Remove the existing fire rated elevator lobby doors and replace with glass doors . Install a new automatic drop down smoke and fire rated curtain .  Replace the existing lobby fire doors with glass doors to provide a visual security of those coming off the elevator prior to visitors entering their office space. Since removing the doors removes the fire rated enclosure for the Elevator Lobby, we are replacing them with the pre-approved, UL listed fire rated fire+smoke curtain product that activates and creates a fire rated enclosure for the Elevator Lobby upon fire and smoke development and fire alarm activation. The fire rated fire+smoke curtain automatically drops down in front of the Elevator Lobby to provide a fire rated Elevator Lobby enclosure instead of using fire rated doors. On the south side of the Lobby the fire rated fire+smoke curtain includes, as part of its approved assembly, a fire rated exit door/flap within the smoke+fire curtain to allow for exiting from within the Elevator Lobby to rated exit stairs.
